title: Add verified context rotation and continuity drift ledger
description: Implement operator-authorized safe context rotation at a configurable default 150k-token threshold. A deterministic monitor advises agents when rotation is due; agents prepare a validated STATE_SNAPSHOT, update one generated human-readable master continuity ledger with snapshot and canonical-state hashes, launch a fresh visible session, require a checksum-bound resume acknowledgement, and only then supersede the old session. Preserve raw history, never clear before verification, and surface snapshot/master/canonical drift.
acceptance_criteria: Token/context status exposes a current-context estimate where the runtime provides one, uses a configurable 150000-token default threshold, and emits a visible rotation recommendation without pretending cumulative transcript usage is exact context usage.

A prepare command validates a STATE_SNAPSHOT v2 draft, captures canonical task-state and touched-path digests, writes the immutable snapshot, and atomically updates one generated master continuity Markdown ledger under a file lock.
Validation detects snapshot tampering, master-ledger divergence, and canonical task drift before resume acknowledgement; raw transcript/history is never deleted.

A replacement session must record a checksum-bound resume acknowledgement before finalize can mark the old session inactive/session_superseded; failed or missing acknowledgement leaves the old session recoverable.

Focused tests cover threshold boundaries, Claude/Codex metric semantics, atomic prepare, drift detection, acknowledgement refusal/success, concurrency/lock behavior, and no-finalize-before-ack; tests are registered in run_tests.sh.

AGENTS guidance, snapshot template, context-rotation guide, and installed launcher prompts describe the proportional soft/hard policy, the 150k default, master ledger, visible-session requirement, and recovery procedure.
